key_insight: An anatomy-aware 3D GAN improved brain MRI inpainting over a simple 3D AutoEncoder but did not outperform the challenge’s Pix2Pix3D baseline.
clinical_relevance: The approach synthesizes healthy-appearing tissue in masked tumor regions for imaging research, without establishing recovery of true anatomy or clinical utility.
method: Mask-aware gated convolutions and mirrored contralateral context guide 3D synthesis.
Attention-modulated skip fusion, boundary-aware refinement, and a local refiner target reconstruction detail.
Training prioritizes voxel-wise and structural reconstruction before low-weight adversarial fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: Official BraTS 2026 Task 4 evaluation across 219 cases yielded mean SSIM 0.658 and PSNR 14.81 dB, lower than local held-out results.
watch_item: Controlled ablations of mirrored context and the two-stage training schedule are still needed to isolate their contributions.
paper_title: Anatomy-Aware 3D GAN with Local Mask Refinement for Brain MRI Inpainting
